disputed.finding: Draft claims Article 2 links the temperature goal to sustainable development and poverty eradication. The notes quote none of this; it appears only as a paraphrase and is not shown as read.
disputed.objection: The notes do not contain the draft's claimed linkage to sustainable development and poverty eradication, but they also do not quote enough Article 2 text to conclusively contradict that paraphrase.

disputed.finding: Article 4(9) quote is spliced with an ellipsis ('every five years ... and be informed by...'). The actual text is 'in accordance with decision 1/CP.21 and any relevant decisions of the CMA and be informed by the outcomes of the global stocktake'. The omitted decision reference matters and the splice obscures it; the quote should be given in full.
disputed.objection: The notes do show a shortened Article 4(9) quote, but they do not provide enough text to verify the omitted decision reference or to prove the splice materially altered the meaning.

disputed.finding: Article 4(9) says 'Each Party shall communicate a nationally determined contribution every five years'. The draft omits that the cycle is operationalised via CMA decisions and that the NDC is 'in accordance with' them.
disputed.objection: The notes confirm the five-year communication duty, but they do not include the full procedural phrasing about decision 1/CP.21 or CMA decisions, so this is a completeness concern rather than a contradiction.

disputed.finding: The first stocktake (2023) is described in the future/neutral way. Today is Nov 2026 and the first GST concluded at COP28 (2023), so the draft is outdated on context: it does not mention the outcome or that the NDC 3.0 round (due 2025) was informed by it. The notes' sources included the GST pages but this was not used.
disputed.objection: The notes mention the first global stocktake in 2023 but do not address the later outcome or current-cycle implications, so this is an unsupported context complaint rather than a contradiction.
